intervention: Calorie restriction (CALERIE 2, 25% prescribed, roughly half achieved) vs ad libitum
quote: CR treatment reduced participants’ DunedinPACE by the 12-month follow-up and this reduction was maintained through follow-up at 24 months (12-month d = −0.29 (95% CI −0.45, −0.13), 24-month d = −0.25 (95% CI −0.41, −0.09)
note_zh: 24 个月的标准化效应；12 个月为 d −0.29。作者换算约为衰老速度慢 2–3%。实际热量限制超过 10% 的人效应更大（d −0.33）。对 PhenoAge、GrimAge 没有显著影响。

intervention: Omega-3 1 g/day (DO-HEALTH)
population: 70 岁以上健康、活跃的成人（瑞士子样本）
quote: Daily omega-3 supplementation reduced the age-acceleration or pace-of-aging values of three of four clocks in our primary analysis (PhenoAge difference (d) = −0.16 (95% confidence interval (CI) −0.02 to −0.30)
note_zh: 析因试验的事后分析；作者换算为约 2.9–3.8 个月的差别。维生素 D 或运动单独使用没有时钟效应。

intervention: Omega-3 1 g/day (DO-HEALTH)
population: 70 岁以上健康、活跃的成人（瑞士子样本）
note_zh: 析因试验的事后分析；作者换算为约 2.9–3.8 个月的差别。维生素 D 或运动单独使用没有时钟效应。

intervention: Omega-3 1 g/day (DO-HEALTH)
population: 70 岁以上健康、活跃的成人（瑞士子样本）
quote: DunedinPACE d = −0.17 (−0.04 to −0.31)
note_zh: 析因试验的事后分析；作者换算为约 2.9–3.8 个月的差别。维生素 D 或运动单独使用没有时钟效应。

intervention: Semaglutide 1.0 mg weekly vs placebo
population: HIV 相关脂肪增生、BMI ≥25、无糖尿病和心血管病的成人
quote: Among second-generation clocks, PhenoAge showed the largest reduction (−4.90 years/year [95% CI: −8.16 to −1.63], P = 0.004)
note_zh: 32 周试验的探索性事后分析；年化数值要乘以 32/52 才是 32 周的变化。人群特殊，不能外推。

intervention: Semaglutide 1.0 mg weekly vs placebo
population: HIV 相关脂肪增生、BMI ≥25、无糖尿病和心血管病的成人
quote: with a more pronounced effect for GrimAge V2 (−2.26 years/year [−3.94 to −0.59], P = 0.009)
note_zh: 32 周试验的探索性事后分析；年化数值要乘以 32/52 才是 32 周的变化。人群特殊，不能外推。

intervention: Semaglutide 1.0 mg weekly vs placebo
population: HIV 相关脂肪增生、BMI ≥25、无糖尿病和心血管病的成人
quote: For DunedinPACE, semaglutide was associated with a 0.09 lower pace of aging (units per year) relative to placebo (95% CI: −0.17 to −0.02, P = 0.010)
note_zh: 32 周试验的探索性事后分析。DunedinPACE 本身就是衰老速度（每年），作者换算为约慢 9%。人群特殊，不能外推。

intervention: Endurance/aerobic training
population: 18 岁以上健康成人
quote: Systolic BP (SBP) was reduced after endurance (−3.5 mm Hg [confidence limits −4.6 to −2.3])
note_zh: 来自 105 个耐力训练组（全分析共 93 项试验、5223 人）。高血压者降得更多（−8.3/−5.2 mmHg），血压正常者约 −0.75/−1.1 mmHg。纳入训练至少 4 周。

intervention: Endurance/aerobic training
population: 18 岁以上健康成人
quote: Reductions in diastolic BP (DBP) were observed after endurance (−2.5 mm Hg [−3.2 to −1.7])
note_zh: 来自 105 个耐力训练组（全分析共 93 项试验、5223 人）。高血压者降得更多（−8.3/−5.2 mmHg），血压正常者约 −0.75/−1.1 mmHg。纳入训练至少 4 周。

intervention: Reduced salt intake (about −4.4 g/day)
population: 有或没有高血压的成人
quote: -4.18 mm Hg (95% confidence interval -5.18 to -3.18, I(2)=75%) for systolic blood pressure
note_zh: 高血压者 −5.39 mmHg，血压正常者 −2.42 mmHg；每天少吃约 6 g 盐，收缩压约降 5.8 mmHg。

intervention: DASH diet
population: 有或没有高血压的成人
quote: Compared with a control diet, the DASH diet reduced both SBP and DBP (difference in means: −3.2 mm Hg; 95% CI: −4.2, −2.3 mm Hg; P < 0.001
note_zh: 钠摄入高于 2400 mg/天、平均年龄小于 50 岁的试验效应更大。

intervention: Mediterranean diet
marker_zh: 超敏 C 反应蛋白
population: 19 岁以上成人
quote: high-sensitive C reactive protein [WMD: -0.98 mg/l, 95% CI -1.48 to -0.49, p < 0.0001; I(2) = 91%]
note_zh: 试验间差异很大（I² = 91%）。纳入干预至少 12 周。

intervention: EPA+DHA 2 g/day
population: 成人（90 项试验中 52 项为高血脂人群）
quote: The mean change in triglyceride was −42.61 (95% CI, −53.41 to −31.80) mg/dL for 2 g/d
note_zh: 剂量反应模型在该摄入量处的平均估计（甘油三酯分析含 86 项试验；全研究 90 项试验、72598 人），效应近似随摄入量线性增加；高血脂、超重者降得更多。

intervention: Structured exercise training
population: 2 型糖尿病患者
quote: structured exercise training (23 studies) was associated with a decline in HbA(1c) level (-0.67%; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.84% to -0.49%
note_zh: 单位是百分点。每周运动超过 150 分钟的试验约 −0.89，150 分钟及以下约 −0.36。人群为 2 型糖尿病，纳入试验至少 12 周。

intervention: Weight loss
population: 成人（平均减重 5.1 kg）
quote: -1.05 mm Hg (95% CI, -1.43 to -0.66) systolic
note_zh: 按每减 1 kg 计。减重超过 5 kg 时收缩压平均 −6.63 mmHg。

intervention: Weight loss
population: 成人（平均减重 5.1 kg）
quote: -0.92 mm Hg (95% CI, -1.28 to -0.55) diastolic
note_zh: 按每减 1 kg 计。减重超过 5 kg 时收缩压平均 −6.63 mmHg。

intervention: Smoking cessation
population: 坚持戒烟的前吸烟者
quote: HDL-C level increased significantly [0.100 (CI 0.074 to 0.127) mmol/L]
note_zh: 前瞻性研究的荟萃分析（非随机）。总胆固醇、LDL-C、甘油三酯没有变化。

intervention: Psyllium (median ~10.2 g/day)
population: 有或没有高胆固醇的成人
quote: significantly reduced LDL cholesterol (MD = -0.33 mmol/L; 95% CI: -0.38, -0.27 mmol/L; P < 0.00001)
note_zh: 纳入干预至少 3 周。

intervention: Plant sterols/stanols (~2.15 g/day)
population: 成人
note_zh: 绝对值约 −0.34 mmol/L。基线 LDL 越高，下降的绝对值越大。

intervention: Reduced alcohol intake
population: 成人（多为男性）
quote: −3·13 mm Hg (95% CI −3·93 to −2·32) for systolic blood pressure
note_zh: 效应取决于原来的饮酒量：每天 2 杯及以下几乎没有变化，每天 6 杯及以上约 −5.5 mmHg。

intervention: Resistance training
population: 2 型糖尿病患者
note_zh: 贝叶斯网络荟萃分析，区间为 95% 可信区间；单位是百分点。127 项试验、8744 人是整个网络的总数，不是抗阻训练一组的人数。

intervention: Dynamic resistance training
population: 健康成人
quote: Systolic BP (SBP) was reduced after endurance (−3.5 mm Hg [confidence limits −4.6 to −2.3]), dynamic resistance (−1.8 mm Hg [−3.7 to −0.011])
note_zh: 29 个动态抗阻训练组；高血压前期的人降得最多（−4.0/−3.8 mmHg）。

intervention: Dynamic resistance training
population: 健康成人
quote: Reductions in diastolic BP (DBP) were observed after endurance (−2.5 mm Hg [−3.2 to −1.7]), dynamic resistance (−3.2 mm Hg [−4.5 to −2.0])
note_zh: 29 个动态抗阻训练组；高血压前期的人降得最多（−4.0/−3.8 mmHg）。

intervention: Time-restricted eating vs ad libitum
population: 成人，健康状况不一
quote: showed a small reduction in body weight for ADF (mean difference −3.40 kg (95% CI −4.14 to −2.67), high certainty of evidence), WDF (−2.36 kg (−3. 02 to −1.70), high certainty of evidence), and CER (−2.11 kg (−2.73 to −1.50), moderate certainty of evidence); while TRE showed a trivial reduction (−1.72 kg (−2.21 to −1.22)
note_zh: 作者评为“微小”的减重；同一网络中持续热量限制为 −2.11 kg。

intervention: Time-restricted eating (≤12 h window)
population: 糖尿病前期或 2 型糖尿病患者
quote: The pooled meta-analysis showed no overall effect of TRE on HbA1c (-3.33 mmol/mol; 95% CI -6.87, 0.20 (-0.30% points; -0.63, 0.02); p=0.06, moderate certainty).
note_zh: 没有显著效应（区间跨过 0）；单位是百分点。糖尿病前期亚组约 −0.09 个百分点，2 型糖尿病亚组不显著。

intervention: DASH diet vs non-DASH (usual or other) diet
population: 代谢综合征成人（常伴高血压、2 型糖尿病或超重）
quote: Seven RCTs (23, 24, 26–29, 35) involving 493 participants reported significant reductions in WC with the DASH diet compared to the non-DASH group (MD = −2.33 cm, 95% CI: −3.10 to −1.57, p < 0.001)
note_zh: 14 项随机试验的荟萃分析，干预 6 周到 6 个月；证据确定性中等。

intervention: DASH diet vs non-DASH (usual or other) diet
population: 代谢综合征成人（常伴高血压、2 型糖尿病或超重）
quote: Ten RCTs (23–26, 28, 29, 31, 34–36) with 766 participants reported a significant reduction in diastolic blood pressure in the DASH group (MD = −3.93 mmHg, 95% CI: −4.76 to −3.10, p < 0.001)
note_zh: 同一荟萃分析中收缩压下降 5.52 mmHg；舒张压各研究之间结果一致。

intervention: DASH diet vs non-DASH (usual or other) diet
population: 代谢综合征成人（常伴高血压、2 型糖尿病或超重）
quote: The DASH diet significantly reduced TG levels compared to the non-DASH group (MD = −16.57 mg/dL, 95% CI: −23.53 to −9.61, p < 0.001)
note_zh: 单位为 mg/dL（约等于 0.19 mmol/L，换算仅供参考）；证据确定性中等。

intervention: DASH diet vs non-DASH (usual or other) diet
population: 代谢综合征成人（常伴高血压、2 型糖尿病或超重）
quote: Eight RCTs (23, 24, 27–29, 32, 33, 35) with 510 participants found no significant effect of the DASH diet on HDL-C levels (MD = 1.90 mg/dL, 95% CI: −0.10 to 3.90, p = 0.06)
note_zh: 总体没有显著变化；去掉一项异质性大的研究后升高 1.44 mg/dL（0.20 到 2.68）。证据确定性低。

intervention: DASH diet vs other diets
population: 成人（多为非酒精性脂肪肝、肥胖或多囊卵巢综合征患者，5 项在伊朗）
quote: The pooled findings from the random effects model exhibited no significant alteration in ALT levels after consuming the DASH diet (mean difference (MD): −3.71 IU/L, 95% CI: −7.813, 0.392, p = 0.076)
note_zh: 干预 8–12 周；总体不显著、研究间差异大。亚组里 44 岁以下、基线 ALT 高于 30 IU/L 或脂肪肝患者下降更明显。

intervention: DASH diet vs other diets
population: 成人（多为非酒精性脂肪肝、肥胖或多囊卵巢综合征患者，5 项在伊朗）
quote: The fixed‐effects model exhibited that consuming the DASH diet led to a notable AST change (mean difference (MD): −3.305 IU/L, 95% CI: −4.709, −1.901, p < 0.001)
note_zh: 干预 8–12 周；固定效应模型。研究数少，多在伊朗。

intervention: DASH diet vs typical or control diet
population: 美国成人（高血压前期或 1 级高血压，或痛风），约四成基线尿酸偏高
quote: The pooled analysis revealed a significant reduction in serum UA following the DASH diet (P < 0.01). The pooled mean difference (MD) of UA from baseline was −0.25 (95% CI −0.40 to −0.10; H–K: −0.50 to −0.01)
note_zh: 干预 4–12 周；基线尿酸高的人下降更多。同文生酮饮食对尿酸没有显著影响。

intervention: Oat beta-glucan ≥3 g/day vs control
intervention_zh: 燕麦 β-葡聚糖（每天至少 3 克）
population: 成人（胆固醇正常或偏高，部分有 2 型糖尿病）
quote: The effect of OBG relative to control on total cholesterol for all studies and dose amounts is shown in Figure 2B. There was some indication of heterogeneity among the studies (P = 0.067). The random-effects meta-analysis showed a statistically significant difference for OBG relative to control of −0.30 mmol/L (95% CI: −0.35, −0.24; P < 0.0001)
note_zh: 试验持续 2–12 周；同文 LDL-C 下降 0.25 mmol/L。剂量和疗程长短没有改变效果；基线 LDL 越高下降越多。

intervention: Oat supplementation interventions (oat foods) vs controls
population: 以高胆固醇、肥胖、轻度代谢异常为主的成人
quote: apolipoprotein B [WMD: − 0.03 g/L, 95% CI (− 0.05; − 0.01)] were significantly lower in the OSI arm compared to the control arm
note_zh: 与米、蛋、其他纤维、小麦等对照食物相比；研究间差异很大。

intervention: Oat supplementation interventions (oat foods) vs controls
population: 以高胆固醇、肥胖、轻度代谢异常为主的成人
quote: In addition, glucose [− 0.25 mmol/L, (− 0.36; -0.14), I2 = 47.9%, Pq = 0.15]
note_zh: 与不吃燕麦的对照比；只有 3 项研究。

intervention: Oat supplementation interventions (oat foods) vs controls
population: 以高胆固醇、肥胖、轻度代谢异常为主的成人
quote: waist circumference (WC) [− 1.06 cm, (− 1.85; − 0.27), I2 = 0%, Pq = 0.61] were lower in the OSI group compared to the control arm
note_zh: 与不吃燕麦的对照比；只有 3 项研究。同一比较中体重下降 0.94 kg。

intervention: Vegan diet (≥12 weeks) vs control diets
population: 超重或 2 型糖尿病成人
quote: The pooled analysis showed that participants following vegan diets achieved greater weight loss compared with control diets (mean difference −4.1 kg, 95% CI −5.9 to −2.4, n = 697, p < 0.001
note_zh: 至少 12 周；和平常饮食比减得更多（−7.4 kg），和其他饮食方案比约 −2.7 kg。部分效果可能来自吃得更少。

intervention: Low glycaemic index/load dietary pattern vs higher GI/GL control diet
intervention_zh: 低升糖指数（低 GI）饮食
population: 1 型或 2 型糖尿病成人（多为中年、超重，血糖中等控制）
quote: triglycerides (−0.09 mmol/L (−0.17 to −0.01), P=0.04; no substantial heterogeneity, I2=44%, P=0.01)
note_zh: 中位随访 12 周；去掉单项研究后可能不再显著。

intervention: Low glycaemic index/load dietary pattern vs higher GI/GL control diet
intervention_zh: 低升糖指数（低 GI）饮食
population: 1 型或 2 型糖尿病成人（多为中年、超重，血糖中等控制）
quote: apo B (−0.05 g/L (−0.09 to −0.01), P=0.03; substantial heterogeneity, I2=58%, P=0.03)
note_zh: 中位随访 12 周；少于 10 项试验比较，去掉单项研究后可能不再显著。

intervention: Low glycaemic index/load dietary pattern vs higher GI/GL control diet
intervention_zh: 低升糖指数（低 GI）饮食
population: 1 型或 2 型糖尿病成人（多为中年、超重，血糖中等控制）
quote: CRP (−0.41 mg/L (−0.78 to −0.04), P=0.03; no substantial heterogeneity, I2=24%, P=0.26)
note_zh: 中位随访 12 周；作者评为很小的下降。6 项试验比较中 5 项明确测的是超敏 CRP。

intervention: Mediterranean diet vs low-fat, standard diabetic diet or usual care
population: 2 型糖尿病成人
quote: Mediterranean dietary interventions were associated with significantly lower FPG levels in random-effects analysis, with pooled mean difference of −0.845 mmol/L (95% CI: −1.307 to −0.384; p < 0.001)
note_zh: 至少 12 周（3 个月到 8 年）；研究间差异中等。同文 HbA1c 下降 0.307 个百分点。

intervention: Vitamin D-fortified milk or milk powder vs unfortified
intervention_zh: 喝维生素 D 强化牛奶
population: 一般人群（儿童和成人，不限健康状况）
quote: The overall meta-analysis results showed that the consumption of vitamin D-fortified milk/milk powder resulted in statistically significant increased serum 25(OH)D concentrations, although the results were highly heterogeneous (MD: 16.10 nmol/L, 95% CI: 12.68–19.53, I2 = 97%)
note_zh: 单位为 nmol/L（÷2.5 约为 ng/mL，换算仅供参考）；研究间差异很大。强化酸奶约 +26.58 nmol/L。

intervention: Exercise training (aerobic, resistance or combined) vs sedentary control
intervention_zh: 规律运动训练（有氧、力量或两者结合）
population: 成年人（排除已知心血管病、癌症等），多为久坐者
quote: A combined analysis of all 211 exercise-training studies reported TC (4542 exercise/3073 controls) was lower by – 5.90 mg/dL or 0.15 mmol/L (95% CI – 8.14, – 3.65)
note_zh: 148 项随机对照试验汇总；训练 3–52 周，最常见 12 周。三种运动方式中有氧+力量结合效果最好。预测区间提示单个研究里效果差别很大。

intervention: Exercise training (aerobic, resistance or combined) vs sedentary control
intervention_zh: 规律运动训练（有氧、力量或两者结合）
population: 成年人（排除已知心血管病、癌症等），多为久坐者
quote: LDL was reduced by – 7.22 mg/dL or 0.19 mmol/L (95% CI – 9.08, – 5.35)
note_zh: 148 项随机对照试验汇总；训练 3–52 周，最常见 12 周。三种运动方式中有氧+力量结合效果最好。预测区间提示单个研究里效果差别很大。

intervention: Exercise training (aerobic, resistance or combined) vs sedentary control
intervention_zh: 规律运动训练（有氧、力量或两者结合）
population: 成年人（排除已知心血管病、癌症等），多为久坐者
quote: TGD was reduced by – 8.01 mg/dL or 0.09 mmol/L (95% CI – 10.45, – 5.58)
note_zh: 148 项随机对照试验汇总；训练 3–52 周，最常见 12 周。三种运动方式中有氧+力量结合效果最好。预测区间提示单个研究里效果差别很大。该指标人数在原文印刷有误（4,26/3,81），未填写。

intervention: Exercise training (aerobic, resistance or combined) vs sedentary control
intervention_zh: 规律运动训练（有氧、力量或两者结合）
population: 成年人（排除已知心血管病、癌症等），多为久坐者
quote: HDL was significantly higher by 2.11 mg/dL or 0.05 mmol/L (95% CI 1.43, 2.79)
note_zh: 148 项随机对照试验汇总；训练 3–52 周，最常见 12 周。三种运动方式中有氧+力量结合效果最好。预测区间提示单个研究里效果差别很大。

intervention: Exercise training (aerobic, resistance, HIIT or combined; ≥4 weeks) vs no exercise
population: 成年非酒精性脂肪肝（NAFLD/NASH）患者
quote: The MD in the reduction of ALT levels was -5.27 U/L (95% CI: −8.84 to −1.70)
note_zh: 运动 8–103 周。年龄越轻下降越多：30–39 岁约降 26 U/L，60 岁以上基本不变。研究之间差别大。

intervention: Exercise training (aerobic, resistance, HIIT or combined; ≥4 weeks) vs no exercise
population: 成年非酒精性脂肪肝（NAFLD/NASH）患者
quote: The average reduction of AST levels was −4.93 U/L (95% CI: −7.94 to −1.91)
note_zh: 运动 8–103 周。只有 30–39 岁组下降明显；研究之间差别大。

intervention: Exercise training (aerobic, resistance, HIIT or combined) vs control
population: 超重或肥胖的代谢相关脂肪肝（MASLD）成人
quote: A total of 13 studies assessing GGT were included, involving 486 participants. The heterogeneity analysis revealed high variability among studies (I2 = 82.2%, P < 0.001); therefore, a random-effects model was applied. The pooled analysis showed an SMD of − 0.29 (95% CI: − 0.75 to 0.17)
note_zh: 标准化效应，不能直接和个人化验单的 U/L 变化比较；没有统计学意义，研究之间差别大。

intervention: Exercise training (aerobic, resistance or combined) vs control
population: 成年人（多数没有心血管病），包括健康者和有代谢风险者
quote: The WMDs between exercise groups and control groups were −1.03 μIU/mL (95% CI −1.69 to −0.37; I2=79.8%; P<0.001 for heterogeneity) for fasting insulin
note_zh: 160 项随机对照试验总汇；胰岛素一项含 29 组比较（运动 1272 人、对照 1149 人，见表 4）。同一分析中空腹血糖变化不显著。

intervention: Combined aerobic + resistance training vs control
population: 久坐成年人
quote: the combined exercise reduced fasting glucose levels (SMD: − 0.474, 95% CI [− 0.829, − 0.120]; Z-value = − 2.622, p = 0.009) (small effect size)
note_zh: 标准化效应，不能直接和个人 mmol/L 的变化比较。研究数量和人数都不多。

intervention: Combined aerobic + resistance training vs control
population: 久坐成年人
quote: combined exercise was effective in reducing CRP levels (SMD: − 0.507, 95% CI [− 0.818, − 0.196], Z-value = − 3.197, p = 0.001) (medium effect size)
note_zh: 标准化效应，不能直接和个人 mg/L 的变化比较。只有 7 项研究、170 人。

intervention: Supervised aerobic exercise, per 30 min/week
intervention_zh: 有氧运动（每周每多 30 分钟）
population: 超重或肥胖的成年人
quote: Each 30 minutes per week of aerobic exercise was associated with body weight reduced by 0.52 kg (95% CI, −0.61 to −0.44
note_zh: 剂量反应：每周多做 30 分钟有氧运动，体重多降约 0.5 kg，到每周 300 分钟仍大致按比例增加。作者认为每周至少 150 分钟中等以上强度，腰围和体脂才有明显下降。全部 116 项试验、6880 人。

intervention: Aerobic exercise vs control
population: 超重或肥胖的成年人
quote: Regular aerobic exercise significantly reduced waist circumference by 3.2 cm (95% confidence interval [CI] −3.86, −2.51, p ≤ 0.001) versus control.
note_zh: 高强度有氧比中等强度降得多（−4.2 cm 对 −2.5 cm）。研究之间差别大。

intervention: Resistance training vs sedentary control
population: 成年人（多为老年人或健康年轻人）
quote: resistance training reduced plasma Hcy concentration (-1.53 μmol/L, 95% CI: -2.77 to -0.28, p = .02), which aerobic training did not (0.19 μmol/L, 95% CI: -0.67 to 1.06, p = .66)
note_zh: 只有 3 项力量训练研究的亚组结果；有氧训练没有效果，全部 7 项训练研究合计也不显著。

intervention: Physical activity intervention vs control
intervention_zh: 增加身体活动（尤其户外）
population: 成年人（随机对照试验汇总）
quote: We found that Vitamin D levels were significantly increased in physical activity group compared to the control (WMD = 4.08 nmol/L; 95% CI: 2.05, 6.11; P < 0.001)
note_zh: 户外活动升得多（约 17 nmol/L），室内活动几乎不变，作者认为主要靠晒太阳。研究之间差别大。

intervention: Behavioural sleep interventions (CBT-I, sleep hygiene or sleep extension) vs control
intervention_zh: 改善睡眠的行为干预（失眠认知行为治疗、睡眠卫生或延长睡眠）
population: 睡眠不好的成人（失眠、睡得短或睡眠质量差），没有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停
quote: Considering all sleep interventions, from 12 studies (n = 688), use of the intervention was associated with a significant reduction in systolic blood pressure levels averaging 4.91 mmHg (95% CI 2.38, 7.43, P < 0.00001, I2 = 74%), compared to control
note_zh: 只合并随机对照试验的结果；研究间差异大（I² 74%）。延长睡眠类研究的降幅比失眠认知行为治疗和睡眠卫生类大。

intervention: CBT-I and/or sleep hygiene vs control
intervention_zh: 失眠认知行为治疗或睡眠卫生指导
population: 睡眠不好的成人（多为失眠），没有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停
quote: within eight studies (n = 618) of CBT-I and/or sleep hygiene interventions, systolic blood pressure levels decreased significantly, averaging 3.44 mmHg (1.07, 5.80; P = 0.004, I2 = 53%) compared to control
note_zh: 随机对照试验亚组；同一篇荟萃分析里，这类干预对舒张压的影响不显著。

intervention: Sleep extension (more time in bed) vs habitual sleep
population: 平时睡得短的成人
quote: In four studies (n = 70) of sleep extension interventions, systolic blood pressure reduction was significant, averaging 8.20 mmHg (4.39, 12.01; P < 0.00001, I2 = 63%).
note_zh: 只有 4 个小型随机试验、共 70 人，多数只做了几周，结果不稳。

intervention: Sleep extension (more time in bed) vs habitual sleep
population: 平时睡得短的成人
quote: For diastolic blood pressure outcomes, the average reductions were not significant within all interventions (P = 0.05) or within CBT-I and/or sleep hygiene studies (P = 0.36). However, use of sleep extension in four studies (n = 70) led to significant reductions averaging 6.62 mmHg (0.97, 12.26, P = 0.02, I2 = 89%) compared to control.
note_zh: 只有 4 个小型随机试验、共 70 人，研究间差异很大（I² 89%）。失眠认知行为治疗和睡眠卫生对舒张压没有显著影响。

intervention: CBT-I and/or sleep hygiene vs control
intervention_zh: 失眠认知行为治疗或睡眠卫生指导
population: 有睡眠问题的成人，大多数是 2 型糖尿病患者
quote: For interventions of CBT-I and/ or sleep hygiene, from 12 studies of 2,044 people, use of the intervention was associated with a significant reduction in HbA1c levels of 0.27% (95% CI 0.07, 0.47) p = 0.008
note_zh: 纳入的研究包括少量非随机试验；研究间差异大（I² 74%）。2 型糖尿病患者降 0.43%，没有糖尿病的人基本不变（0.0%）。空腹血糖没有显著变化。

intervention: CBT-I and/or sleep hygiene vs control, people with type 2 diabetes
intervention_zh: 失眠认知行为治疗或睡眠卫生指导（2 型糖尿病）
population: 有睡眠问题的 2 型糖尿病患者
quote: Considering the sub-analysis for 1,911 people with T2DM from 9 studies, use of the interventions demonstrated an HbA1c level decrease of 0.43% (0.19, 0.67), p = 0.0004
note_zh: 只适用于 2 型糖尿病患者；没有糖尿病的 3 项研究里糖化血红蛋白没有变化。

intervention: Behavioural sleep interventions vs control, baseline obesity
intervention_zh: 改善睡眠的行为干预（肥胖人群）
population: 睡眠不好、基线已属肥胖的成人
quote: When body weight was used as the outcome, the postintervention average reductions were significant when the mean baseline BMI levels were in obesity category, averaging 5.55 kg (4.13, 6.97, p < 0.00001, I 2 = 0%, T 2 = 0.0) in three studies (n = 72)
note_zh: 按基线 BMI 分组的结果，只有 3 项研究、72 人，随机和非随机研究合并。全部人群合并时体重下降不显著。

intervention: Behavioural sleep interventions vs control, baseline overweight
intervention_zh: 改善睡眠的行为干预（超重人群）
population: 睡眠不好、基线属超重的成人
quote: When body weight was used as the outcome, the postintervention average reductions were significant when the mean baseline BMI levels were in obesity category, averaging 5.55 kg (4.13, 6.97, p < 0.00001, I 2 = 0%, T 2 = 0.0) in three studies (n = 72), and also in overweight category, averaging 0.83 kg (0.32, 1.35, p = 0.002, I 2 = 0%, T 2 = 0.0) in six studies (n = 337)
note_zh: 按基线 BMI 分组的结果，随机和非随机研究合并。全部人群合并时体重下降不显著；BMI 正常的人没有变化。

intervention: Individualised sleep-hygiene counselling to extend bedtime to 8.5 h vs habitual sleep (2 weeks)
intervention_zh: 延长睡眠时间（个体化睡眠指导，目标卧床 8.5 小时）
population: 21–40 岁、超重（BMI 25.0–29.9）、平时每晚睡不到 6.5 小时的成人，在日常生活中
quote: Participants in the sleep extension group had a statistically significant reduction in weight compared with those in the control group (−0.87 kg; 95% CI, −1.39 to −0.35 kg; P = .001).
note_zh: 只做了 2 周；主要机制是每天少吃了约 270 千卡。对照组体重增加 0.39 kg，延长睡眠组减少 0.48 kg。

intervention: CPAP for obstructive sleep apnoea vs inactive control (device therapy)
intervention_zh: 睡眠呼吸暂停的持续正压通气（CPAP，呼吸机）治疗
population: 同时有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停和 2 型糖尿病的成人
quote: CPAP treatment led to a significant reduction in haemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) (mean difference −0.24%, 95% CI −0.43– −0.06%, p=0.001) compared to inactive control groups.
note_zh: 这是医疗设备治疗，需要医生诊断睡眠呼吸暂停后使用，不是一般的睡眠习惯调整。每晚用得越久，下降越多。

intervention: Smoking cessation without treatment (abstinent quitters, 12 months)
population: 戒烟试验中成功戒烟、未用戒烟药的人
quote: In untreated quitters, mean weight gain was 1.12 kg (95% confidence interval 0.76 to 1.47), 2.26 kg (1.98 to 2.54), 2.85 kg (2.42 to 3.28), 4.23 kg (3.69 to 4.77), and 4.67 kg (3.96 to 5.38) at one, two, three, six, and 12 months after quitting, respectively.
note_zh: 与戒烟前相比的体重变化（不是与继续吸烟的人比）。个人差别很大：约 16% 的人体重下降，13% 增加超过 10 kg。戒烟的健康收益远大于体重增加。

intervention: Weight loss interventions (diet and/or exercise) vs no or less intensive intervention
population: 非酒精性脂肪肝成人
quote: clear evidence showed that blood markers for liver disease improved, including ALT (–9.81 U/L; 95% CI, –13.12 to –6.50; I2 = 97%
note_zh: 脂肪肝人群；研究之间差异很大（I² 97%）。更强化的减重方案平均多减约 3.6 kg。

intervention: Weight loss interventions (diet and/or exercise) vs no or less intensive intervention
population: 非酒精性脂肪肝成人
note_zh: 脂肪肝人群；研究之间差异很大（I² 96%）。全部 22 项试验、2588 人，报告 AST 的试验数见原文补充材料。

intervention: Weight loss interventions (diet and/or exercise) vs no or less intensive intervention
population: 非酒精性脂肪肝成人
quote: and in GGT was –4.35 U/L (95% CI, –7.67 to –1.04; I2 = 92%
note_zh: 脂肪肝人群；研究之间差异很大（I² 92%）。

intervention: Weight loss interventions (diet and/or exercise) vs no or less intensive intervention
population: 非酒精性脂肪肝成人
quote: The change in ALP was –5.53 U/L (95% CI, –20.48 to 9.22; I2 = 96%
note_zh: 置信区间跨过 0：没有看到确定的变化。

intervention: Coach-directed behavioral weight loss (telephone coaching) vs self-directed weight loss, 12 months (SPIRIT)
population: 超重或肥胖、无痛风的癌症康复者（平均 60 岁，79% 女性）
quote: compared to the self-directed group, the coach-directed group unexpectedly increased SU by 0.3 mg/dL (95% CI: 0.05, 0.6)
note_zh: 与预期相反：BMI 只多降 0.9，尿酸反而略升；作者认为与肾功能变化有关。小规模单个试验。

intervention: Mindfulness-Based Blood Pressure Reduction (MB-BP) program vs enhanced usual care
intervention_zh: 正念减压（针对血压的正念课程）
population: 诊室血压偏高的成人（平均 59.5 岁）
quote: MB‐BP was associated with a 5.9‐mm Hg reduction (95% CI, −9.1 to −2.8 mm Hg) in systolic BP from baseline and outperformed the control group by 4.5 mm Hg at 6 months (95% CI, −9.0 to −0.1 mm Hg)
note_zh: 6 个月时与对照组相比的差值；自身前后下降约 5.9 mmHg。

intervention: Mindfulness-based interventions vs control
population: 患慢性非传染性疾病（如高血压、糖尿病）的成人
quote: the pooled estimate of the mean intervention effect on BP was high with significant effects in comparison to the control groups for SBP (-5.53 mmHg [95% CI: -7.81, -3.25]) and DBP (-2.13 mmHg [95% CI: -2.97, -1.30])
note_zh: 同一分析中收缩压 −5.53 mmHg。研究之间差异较大，多数为 8–12 周的课程。

intervention: Mindfulness-based intervention vs control
population: 1 型或 2 型糖尿病患者
quote: After pooling, the mean reduction in HbA1c was 0.25% (95% CI −0.43 to −0.07; P = 0.006), with no substantial heterogeneity between studies
note_zh: 糖尿病人群；对没有糖尿病的人未必适用。

intervention: Mind-body interventions (meditation, mindfulness, yoga, tai chi, qigong and similar) vs control
intervention_zh: 身心练习（冥想、正念、瑜伽、太极等）
population: 各类人群（健康人、压力大者、慢病患者等）
quote: Post-intervention, MBIs slightly affected the levels of CRP (SMD = −0.12; 95% CI, −0.23 to −0.01)
note_zh: 标准化效应，不能直接和个人的 CRP 数值比较；效应很小。

intervention: Static meditation practice vs no meditation
population: 健康或亚健康成人
quote: individuals engaged in regular static meditation exhibited lower cholesterol levels by approximately 14 mg/dL compared to non-meditators (MD = −13.91 [−23.35; −4.47] mg/dL; p = 0.02; 245 subjects)
note_zh: 只有 4 个小型随机试验；去掉高偏倚研究后约 −10.88 mg/dL。

intervention: Static meditation practice vs no meditation
population: 健康或亚健康成人
quote: The meta-analysis examining variations in LDL cholesterol levels associated with meditation included five RCTs [43,45,46,47,48] (Figure 4): the overall result showed a significant difference in favor of the intervention (MD = −7.83 [−12.62; −3.03] mg/dL; p = 0.01; 280 subjects)
note_zh: 小型随机试验；单位是 mg/dL。

intervention: Static meditation practice vs no meditation
population: 健康或亚健康成人
quote: The meta-analysis examining the modifications in triglyceride levels associated with meditation included five RCTs [43,44,45,46,47] (Figure 5): the overall result showed a significant difference in favor of the intervention (MD = −32.56 [−48.44; −16.68] mg/dL; p < 0.01; 313 subjects)
note_zh: 小型随机试验，效应可能偏大；单位是 mg/dL。

intervention: Static meditation practice vs no meditation
population: 健康或亚健康成人
quote: The meta-analysis examining changes in HDL cholesterol levels associated with meditation showed no significant difference between the intervention and control (MD = 0.91 [−4.42; 6.24] mg/dL; p = 0.68; 348 subjects)
note_zh: 没有看到确定的变化；研究之间差异很大（I² 91%）。
